title: Policy Document Metadata
description: Metadata for a generated or ingested HR policy PDF, including ground-truth parameters for eval.

policy_type.description: Policy category slug — one of ten standard HR policy types.

title.description: Display title shown in PDF header and citations.

effective_date.description: ISO 8601 date when this policy version becomes effective.

status.description: active = current policy; archived = superseded but retained for version tests.

file_path.description: Relative path to the PDF from repository root.

parameters.description: Ground-truth policy parameters used for generation and golden eval Q&A.

annual_leave_days.description: leave_policy — paid annual leave days for full-time staff.

probation_months.description: leave_policy, performance — probation period length in months.

carry_forward_limit.description: leave_policy — max leave days carried to next year.

remote_days_per_week.description: remote_work — allowed WFH days per week.

health_insurance_coverage_pct.description: benefits — employer share of health premium.

expense_reimbursement_days.description: expense — SLA days to reimburse approved expenses.

generated_at.description: Optional timestamp when synthetic document was generated.
